verifiable-quality-gates.why: the parity gate is a check proven to detect: adding an unclassified check:dummy script makes test/self-check-parity.test.mjs fail naming it, and the pre-push fails closed on a missing or malformed self-checks.json
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added self-checks.json + a discriminating parity test, made the pre-push hook fail closed instead of running a hardcoded list, and converged the self-dogfood fixture's gate list onto self-checks.json (no hand-synced second copy); proved discrimination by adding check:dummy and seeing the test go red, then reverting
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the single-source-of-truth decision (one committed file the hook and the test both read, replacing a hardcoded list) is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR with the change
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0071 documenting the parity gap, the self-checks.json source of truth, the fail-closed hook, the discriminating test, the repo-self scope, and the honest limits
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: a repo-invariant (package.json check:* must stay in parity with the committed classification and the hook) is pinned at the level that owns it, a config-reading test in npm test, matching required-checks.test.mjs and coverage-map.test.mjs, not an end-to-end job
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: added a parity test that reads package.json, self-checks.json, and the hook file and asserts their consistency
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the drift cases were enumerated and committed as executable assertions: an unclassified check, an orphaned classification, a classification missing its reason, and the hook no longer sourcing from the file
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: four node:test cases covering those non-happy drift paths plus the hollow-hook case
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: the discrimination claim is backed by a re-runnable reproduction (add check:dummy, the test fails naming it) and the ADR states the honest limits (guards the check:* layer, not the full CI job graph; traveling to consumers is future work)
skeptical-audit.what: proved discrimination and recorded the verification limits and the repo-self scope in ADR-0071
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the change before opening the PR and recorded in the arch-review log
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent over self-checks.json, the hook, and the test, resolved findings, and recorded the review
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

pattern-selector.why: no new pattern was selected; the change reuses the single-source-of-truth approach gate-manifest.json already establishes (one committed file read by every consumer of it) rather than choosing a new structure

arch-encode.why: this IS the arch-encode of a caught drift risk, but it is enforced by a test guarding a committed source of truth, not by a new rule in a rules file

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is build/gate configuration and a test

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed; this governs the repo's own check topology

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the hook reads a committed JSON and spawns npm with gate names from that trusted file

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism changed; the version bump + release are standard library versioning, not a production rollout

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; this is developer-facing gate configuration

universal-browser-device-support.why: no frontend or browser-facing code; this is developer-facing gate configuration

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; this is developer-facing gate configuration
